description: Searches ProprioSign’s guides for Québec landlords (deadlines, how to send the notice, proof of receipt, co-tenants, tenant refusal or no reply, tenant leaving, rooms, indeterminate leases, language of the notice, e-signature). Returns titles, links and summaries.

lang.description: Only guides in this language. If missing, the best version of each guide is returned.

limit.description: Number of guides to return. Default: 5.

query.description: Words to look for, in French or English. Example: "locataire refuse augmentation" or "co-tenants".

name: search_guides
title: Search ProprioSign guides
